semantics.order: sourceOrdinal is lexical order, not a flattened runtime sequence; controlFlow retains loops, branches, continue and break.
semantics.Add: Dictionary.Add: duplicate present key throws; guarded Add skips when ContainsKey guard is false. No implicit union or last-wins rewrite.
semantics.Remove: Dictionary.Remove: missing key is a no-op; existing key is removed. A !ContainsKey guard makes Remove ineffectual.
semantics.whitelist: Final configured whitelist removes prior entries. Its default is metadata, never assumed deployment configuration.
semantics.scope: GetIllegalItem only; commented-out difficulty block is not executable source and is listed separately.
semantics.unknown: Runtime facts, NPC collection and configuration remain symbolic; this extractor does not execute or qualify any rule.
